method: Spherical area approximation of source GeoJSON exterior rings minus interior rings; candidate screening only. Parent ratios compare source ADM2 to normalized-name source ADM1. The representative point selects a parent candidate. This is not equal-area GIS overlay, complete edge coverage, or a geographic approval.

flags.name: Bamako
flags.flag: single source ADM2 child at the representative point and same/near-coextensive with source ADM1; tier purpose needs individual review
flags.recommendation: Engineering should verify Bamako's separate district/cercle role against the current official 2023 source, then correct only its role/rationale if supported. Preserve its ID, geometry and parent until current source review; do not merge or delete the feature from area equality alone.

flags.name: Nouadhibou
flags.flag: single source ADM2 child at the representative point and same/near-coextensive with source ADM1; tier purpose needs individual review
flags.recommendation: Engineering should not retain 'Mauritania' as an administrative source role; source restoration/review should crosswalk the 2020 polygons to DCIG/UN SALB 2021–2023 or later official moughataa data before changing labels, parent links or footprints.

limits: Bamako source ADM2 and ADM1 geometry equality is exact in the retained pinned GeoJSON, but role/purpose requires current legal source review.

Nouadhibou's source ADM2 is approximately 90.16% of the Dakhlet Nouadhibou ADM1 screen area and is a single-child parent candidate; do not infer a city fragment, a mistaken parent or a required merge from area ratio alone.
Source administrative extents and point counts do not establish the boundaries of cities or settlements; no urban footprint or complete settlement source was inspected.
